announcements.text: Akiak NS LLC, Alexandria, Virginia, is awarded $43,282,210 for a firm-fixed-price bridge action (HT001126FE061) to obtain technology lifecycle support services to the Technology Support Branch. Technology lifecycle support (TLS) encompasses various activities including assessment, planning, implementation, and ongoing support to ensure that technology remains efficient, secure, and aligned with the organization’s needs and objectives. The scope of the bridge requirement encompasses seven domains: Digital Transformation Center; system lifecycle management; evolutionary architecture and design; Operations Support Center; service level management; systems architecture; and application support. TLS permits the branch to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, minimize risks, and better leverage technology investments to drive business success. The TLS V1 bridge contractor shall fully cooperate with all support contractors for the remaining three TLS domains as well as others operating in the Defense Health Agency (DHA). The contract has one base period of eight and a half months, and one unexercised option period of three and a half months, for a cumulative total contract value of $43,282,210. fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $30,060,920 will be obligated for the base period. The place of performance is Falls Church, Virginia. DHA, Professional Services Contracting Division, Falls Church, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded Sept. 11, 2026).
